Thanksgiving 2026 Operating Hours

Dining is open over break for our fam who plan to stay on campus. Locations may have modified hours between Tuesday, November 24 and Sunday, November 29. The Columbia-Barnard Exchange will operate during Thanksgiving Break. 

All residential and retail units will resume normal operating hours on November 30.
